A total of 18 teams competed in the league. The season began on 14 February and finished on 13 December. [[Buriram United F.C.|Buriram United]] were the defending champions, having won their Thai Premier League title the [[2014 Thai Premier League|previous season]]. [[Nakhon Ratchasima F.C.|Nakhon Ratchasima]], [[Saraburi F.C.|Saraburi]] and [[Royal Thai Navy F.C.|Navy]] entered as the three promoted teams. ==Teams== A total of 18 teams contested the league, including 15 sides from the 2014 season and three promoted from the [[2014 Thai Division 1 League]]. [[Police United F.C.|Police United]], [[PTT Rayong F.C.|PTT Rayong]], [[Songkhla United F.C.|Songkhla United]], [[Air Force Central F.C.|Air Force Central]] and [[Samut Songkhram F.C.|GSE Samut Songkhram]] were relegated to the 2015 Thai Division 1 League after finishing the [[2014 Thai Premier League|2014 season]]. They were replaced by the best three teams from the [[2014 Thai Division 1 League]] champions [[Nakhon Ratchasima F.C.|Nakhon Ratchasima]], runners-up [[Saraburi F.C.|Saraburi]] and third place
